source: Primary literature and first-party regulatory labels searched 2026-10-03; values are same-entity human oral or oral-mucosal observations, never fit inputs.

citation.location: abstract; reference formulation AUC0-inf 5043.2 ng*h/mL after 200 mg

observations.quote: AUC0-∞ ... 5,043.2 ng×h×mL−1 ... A single oral dose of amisulpride (200 mg)

drugs.notes: This is AUC/dose, not absolute F; the paper reports relative bioavailability between two oral formulations.

observations.quote: The absolute bioavailability of sublingual asenapine at 5 mg is 35%.
The absolute bioavailability of asenapine when swallowed is low (<2% with an oral tablet formulation).

drugs.notes: The PET regimen is sublingual; the swallowed value is retained as a route distinction, not silently substituted.

observations.quote: The oral clearance of escitalopram is 600 mL/min, with approximately 7% of that due to renal clearance.

drugs.notes: The same value is already transcribed in the frozen P28.4 record; this row makes its oral-exposure role explicit without changing the frozen truth.

observations.quote: Following administration of 40 mg of LATUDA, the mean (%CV) apparent clearance was 3902 (18.0) mL/min.
It is estimated that 9-19% of an administered dose is absorbed.

drugs.notes: The label calls the 9-19% quantity absorbed, not a measured absolute F; it is stored as a range and not collapsed to its midpoint.

observations.quote: Milnacipran is well absorbed after oral administration with an absolute bioavailability of approximately 85% to 90%.

drugs.notes: The range is preserved because the label does not print a single study-level point estimate.

observations.quote: By substantial first pass metabolism the absolute bioavailability is reduced to approximately 50 %.
The geometric mean ... C_L/F of paroxetine ... given alone ... was 33.1 liters/h

drugs.notes: Paroxetine is nonlinear with dose and CYP2D6 phenotype; this is a cited regimen-specific value, not a drug-wide constant.
The paper does not report absolute F; this AUC/dose is therefore the admissible oral-exposure truth.

observations.quote: The absolute bioavailability of venlafaxine is about 45%.
Mean±SD steady-state plasma clearance of venlafaxine ... is 1.3±0.6 L/h/kg

drugs.notes: ODV is active and has a separate apparent clearance; the parent and ODV observations are not pooled.
